entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Kushan Empire, a political institution in India during Post-Mauryan and Classical Period (185 BCE–300). Grew from Ashoka. Led to the emergence of Shunga, Satavahana, and Kushan Kingdoms and Shunga.
